name: Thaw Valley
setting: Snowy valley that melts into floods: a fox family den, seed spots, frozen creeks, and the Master Bell on a hill (Fern act3-levels-22-24.md §2). Starts in Master Bell state A (winter, night, north wind). Baby: fawn. Enemy: Prowling Fox.
state: Master Bell A: winter / night / north wind (start state). B and C deltas below.
setpiece: Frozen creek 1 with ice sheets, snow piles and snowy pines, the fox den on the far bank, the Master Bell on its hill under a big lavender moon glow.
how_to_apply: import PRESET_B from preset-B.json; const P = deepMerge(structuredClone(PRESET_B), presetB_override); const fx = applyPresetB(scene, renderer, { quality, camera, target, sky: true }, P); const composer = createComposerB(renderer, scene, camera, fx, P); then add extras.fills, materials from extras.emissive / water / ice.

low.note: no post; grade baked into lights (quality.low.bakeGrade); vignette via cssOverlayB

extras.background: sky dome (night A); the "sun" is the moon key

emissive.rule: Snow and ice have NO emissive; snow albedo <= #f4f2fc so it stays under the 0.88 bloom threshold.

ice.note: Ice must read as solid and walkable-looking-but-slick; never glowing (QA 3).

water.rule: Underwater/flooded camera: drop opacity to 0.55 and add fog #8fc8e8 near 2 far 18 so the ford stones stay visible.

states.transition: Lerp all values over 1.2 s on master:A/B/C; snow piles scale out over the same time.

extras.terrain: Smooth rolling snowfield: 0.6 m low-frequency noise, rounded creek banks (1.5 m fillet), ramps as smooth slopes. flatShading false; snow vertex colours #eef0fb..#dfe2f4 with lilac in the hollows.

crewFloor.reference: 80% of each animal's median relative luminance in the base-B daylight frame (L23: bear 0.058, raccoon 0.050, bee 0.396)
crewFloor.note: measured at 1x from the id-masks; night/cave/dusk must keep the crew as readable as daylight B (QA 5)

budget_note: Counts are renderer.info.render per frame INCLUDING the shadow pass, at 390x844 portrait gameplay framing. Game "High" on phones = preset medium (QA diff 1), so phone High uses the Medium column; desktop Ultra may use preset high.
instancing: One InstancedMesh per (geometry, material) pair for every repeated deco: trees, flowers, grass tufts, rocks, crystals, fence/hedge segments, snow piles, pickups (petals). Never one Mesh per placement.

Merge static, non-interactive level geometry (terrain chunk + lane walls + backdrop) per 16 m z-chunk and per material with BufferGeometryUtils.mergeGeometries; keep interactables (levers, plates, mirrors, gates, bell) as their own meshes.
Atlas / share materials: <= 12 distinct materials per level on Low, <= 20 on High; reuse one pastelized MeshStandardMaterial per colour (cache by hex), and use vertex colours for terrain and rocks.
Shadows: only crew, babies, enemies and props taller than 1.5 m cast. Terrain, walls, small deco and pickups receive only. Low: 1024 PCF on, caster list = crew + babies + enemies only.
Cull: fog far is a hard draw distance. Hide (visible=false) any chunk whose nearest edge is beyond fog far + 5 m; never draw the full corridor.
World-space badges / rings / halos: one shared sprite material + InstancedMesh or a single Points cloud; cap screen size (QA minor 9).
Pollen motes stay the single InstancedMesh from makePollenMotesB.

deviations.why: Ice vs snow and bee vs snow hollow were < 10 dE in grayscale; thin ice must read on every display.
deviations.approved: Approved by Chaz, 14 Nov 2026 (CVD swatch deviations)

deviations.what: Night moon key 1.7 at 32 deg, cool
deviations.why: State A is night; the moon still gives the crew a key and readable contact shadows.

deviations.what: Snow-bounce hemi ground #e0d4ee, intensity 1.6 + warm crew fill
deviations.why: Night readability: fixes the QA 5 failure mode (black silhouettes) without killing the night.
Snow is the brightest surface; it must not bloom.

deviations.what: Ice/water with zero emissive, preset water colours
deviations.why: Avoids QA 3; the creek states are gameplay and must stay readable.
Night depth and fewer far draws.

approvals.item: CVD swatch deviations (every deviation starting "Palette for CVD")

cvd_method: Machado 2009 severity 1.0 (protan, deutan, tritan) + grayscale (relative luminance); CIE76 in sRGB-D65 Lab; pass at dE >= 10.

1.major: High that is not the real High
1.setting: quality block: every level lists High/Medium/Low separately; phone "High" is labelled Medium-equivalent (pixelRatio 1.5, 2048 shadow, half-res bloom) and the budget is set per tier.

2.setting: terrain block: smooth heightfield, flatShading false, rounded terrace shoulders / ledge lips; collision unchanged.

3.setting: water/ice blocks: preset water colours, emissive 0, opacity <= 0.88 (0.6 spray), underwater-camera rule.

4.setting: budget block + instancing guide + fog far as draw distance.

5.setting: fills + hemi + exposure + crewFloor (median crew luminance checked on the frames).
